timing_statement: This reservation was committed after the V5 W10-W14 diagnostic evidence was known, but before any H01-H16 market outcome was opened or evaluated. The holdout dates are selected by the deterministic rule below and are not chosen from their performance.

selection.universe: Every Monday-start seven-day interval fully inside each calendar quarter from 2022Q1 through 2025Q4.
selection.method: For each quarter, list eligible Monday starts, exclude any candidate whose three-day warmup through evaluation end overlaps an exposed Candidate 12 W1-W6 or Candidate 14 W10-W14 evaluation interval, then select one using Python random.Random(seed) consumed in chronological quarter order.

claim_rules: No strategy, threshold, order, cost, risk, target, stop, session route, semantic or arbitration change is permitted after this reservation.
All 16 intervals must complete under exact candidate, protocol and source provenance.
Any strategy change invalidates H01-H16 and requires different untouched intervals.
Passing this non-contiguous holdout is necessary but not sufficient for live readiness; a continuous frozen evaluation must follow.
